ownerAuthority: Finish Inspector search/filter tests under the existing 300-second auto idle rule; preserve active owner input and update GitHub.

findings.finding: Physical clicking an own Inspector popup menu item outside the normal window was rejected as covered before delivery.
findings.fix: Recognize own menu/menu-item ancestry in the AX hit, with matching process identity and the existing expected-node check. Other own hits retain normal-window and overlay checks.

findings.finding: A subsequent live attempt was interrupted by a focus change and the filtered idle monitor returned below 300 seconds.
findings.scope: This run did not establish a search/filter result. Shared input stopped and the task-owned Inspector was later closed without foreground input.

findings.finding: After repeated reopen, the Inspector AX frame no longer matched its rendered WindowServer frame; one broader diagnostic read exceeded the client timeout.
findings.fix: Create a fresh Inspector controller after close, disable ordering animations, publish passive frame readiness, bound AX reads between messages and keep passive Inspector/pointer recovery off the action queue.

findings.finding: The first fixture-control count changed from 16 to 17 after activation/enhanced Accessibility.
findings.scope: The test now reacquires current fixture controls rather than treating the startup count as a fixed UI contract. This is a test correction, not a claimed app defect.

findings.finding: A foreground focus command could not activate the accessory app itself while idle remained above 300 seconds; no hardware input was sent.
findings.fix: Self activation now runs on the main thread, raises the pinned key-capable window and preserves the original cancellation generation.

findings.finding: Some existing-helper clicks were acknowledged or rejected without a verified UI outcome. The exact cause is not established.
findings.fix: Expose the separate macOS event-synthesizing preflight and return event_posting_permission_required before event delivery when that actual OS capability is absent. Background AX actions remain available.
findings.scope: This diagnostic does not claim the existing helper lacked that permission.

pending: Complete physical search/filter/selection on the fixed native build
Verify own physical menu targeting and activation on the fixed native build after any genuine macOS consent
limits: Read budgets are checked between AX messages; per-message timeouts do not establish a hard real-time guarantee.
The new native 1.3.5 candidate is staged; installed live verification remains separate.
currentStatus: Tested fixes published; fixed native build staged. Existing approved helper restored after real macOS signature-consent gate. Physical fixed-build tests remain pending that handoff.
